question: According to Census of India 2011, which state/union territory has the second highest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, **Puducherry** has the second highest sex ratio among states and union territories.
 
• Sex ratio is an important demographic indicator that reflects the number of females per 1000 males in a population.
 
• In the Census of 2011, Puducherry recorded a sex ratio of 1037 females per 1000 males, which is the second highest after Kerala.
 
• This high sex ratio indicates better gender balance and can be attributed to various social and healthcare factors prevailing in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years and is the most comprehensive source of demographic data in the country.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872 and provides extensive data on various demographic parameters.
 
• Sex ratio is a crucial metric for understanding the social structure and gender dynamics within a region.
 
• Efforts to improve the sex ratio include various government initiatives aimed at empowering women and improving healthcare services for girls and women.
